prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio, three women in a single row.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side in a daytime intercity train carriage with blue upholstered seats in rows along both sides of the aisle, luggage racks overhead, large windows showing blurred countryside, bright ceiling lights, a clean linoleum floor. Behind them, several ordinary passengers sitting in the seats and walking along the aisle are softly out of focus, their figures and faces blurred by shallow depth of field into gentle shapes and colours, while the women stay razor sharp in the foreground, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 3 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, bright daylight from the windows raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, with the sweet look of a Japanese idol, soft full cheeks with a gently tapering jaw and a small chin, very large round dark eyes with a wide gaze, softly rounded brows, a small nose and small full lips, deeply sun-tanned bronze makeup over real skin, bold white eyeshadow across the lids, white glossy lips, a bright turquoise liner accent at the outer corners, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a quiet, serious expression, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in a classic French braid from the crown, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, holographic finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links, her hands hanging low in front of her hips.

Left woman's pose: standing full height, facing the camera, close beside the other women, her shoulders slightly lowered, her head bowed a little, her bare feet close together flat on the floor, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Left woman's footwear: bare feet flat on the floor.
